XML/structured template pattern: `<entry>` and `</entry>` tags suggest a templated format for organizing a specific debugging story or example.

The prompt establishes a Q&A or journaling context about a "recent debugging experience," so the next content should be a concrete technical narrative or example.

The repetition pattern of `<entry>`/`</entry`.</explanation>
